ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a contour topographic map. The main solid-line river channel generally extends from the lower left, that is, the southwest direction, toward the upper right, that is, the northeast direction. On the southwest side and slightly west of the river channel, higher contour values can be seen, such as 500, 400, 300, 200, etc.; when the river channel extends toward the northeast and slightly east side, the nearby contour values tend to be lower, approaching low-value areas such as 100. Reasoning: On a topographic map, a river should flow from high elevation to low elevation, so this main river should flow from the higher terrain in the southwest to the lower terrain in the northeast.

raw_record.question_text:
Read "a contour topographic map of a certain region in China" (the dashed line indicates the planned highway).

<image1>

What is the flow direction of the main river in the figure?

method.method_draft: First describe the contour map: identify the main solid river channel trending roughly from the lower-left/southwest part of the map toward the upper-right/northeast part. Read the contour values around the channel: the southwest/western side is adjacent to higher labeled contours, and the river continues toward lower terrain in the northeast/eastern side. Since rivers flow downhill from high elevation to low elevation, conclude that the main river flows from southwest to northeast.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一幅等高线地形图，主要实线河道大致沿左下方即西南方向向右上方即东北方向延伸。河道西南侧、偏西一带可见较高的等高线数值，如500、400、300、200等；河道向东北、偏东一侧延伸时，附近等高线数值趋低，接近100等低值区域。推理：河流在地形图上应由海拔高处流向海拔低处，因此该主要河流应从西南部较高地势流向东北部较低地势。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the solid main river line running diagonally across the map and note its southwest end lies near higher contour labels around the western/southwestern hills, while its northeast end is toward lower/eastward contour values. Use the latitude/longitude frame to keep the map orientation as north-up, east-right.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: On a topographic map, river water flows from higher elevation to lower elevation; map directions are interpreted with north at the top unless otherwise indicated.

method.method_draft: First describe the map features: separate the dashed proposed road from the solid sinuous main river, then focus on the contour lines that cross or wrap around the river valley. Observe that the contour bends/V-shapes along the valley point toward the southwest, indicating the upstream direction. Rivers flow opposite the upstream-pointing V, so the downstream direction is toward the northeast. Therefore the main river flows from southwest to northeast.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是等高线地形图，虚线表示拟建公路线，应与图中穿过谷地的实线弯曲主河流区分开。主河流附近有多条等高线横切或围绕河谷，河谷处等高线形成明显的弯曲/V形。再推理：等高线在河谷处的V形尖端指向河流上游；图中这些V形弯曲总体指向西南方向，说明西南为上游。河流流向与上游指向相反，因此下游方向为东北。由此判断，图中主要河流从西南流向东北。
